BENGALURU CITY, SCCH-14 AND ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION AS PRAYED IN THE CLAIM PETITION OR BY AWARDING SUCH SUM THAT THIS HON'BLE COURT FEELS JUST AND REASONABLE AND TO PASS SUCH ORDER AS CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE AND ALLOW THE APPEAL WITH COST AND INTEREST, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.
 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY

,
JUDGMENT

WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the appellant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 challenging the judgment and award dated 20.10.2018 passed in MVC No.7566/2016, by the Motor Vehicles Accident Claims Tribunal at Bengaluru, (SCCH-14) for enhancing the compensation.

entities.text: Motor Vehicles Accident Claims Tribunal at Bengaluru, (SCCH-14)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard the arguments of learned counsel appearing for the appellant and respondent No.2. Notice to NC: 2025:KHC:34814 HC-KAR respondent No.1 is dispensed with vide order dated 18.01.2024.
3. The status of the parties before the Tribunal is retained for the sake of convenience.
4. It is a case of injury, injured claimant filed a claim petition claiming compensation of Rs.10,00,000/-.
The Tribunal considering the evidence on record, granted Rs.50,000/- lumpsum amount with interest at the rate of 7% per annum from the date of petition till its realization.

Aggrieved by the said judgment and award, he preferred this appeal and mainly contended that he sustained multiple fractures as per the evidence of PW-2 and was hospitalized for one month but no amounts were granted for pain and sufferings, mental agony, nutrition, food, conveyance, attendant charges and loss of earnings.
Therefore, prays for enhancement of compensation.

As per evidence of Sri Hanumegowda C B vs Mr. Ramesh G P on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101218227/
2 PW-2, petitioner has sustained the following injuries:-
NC: 2025:KHC:34814 HC-KAR "Poly trauma; Multiple rib fracture on left side, with haemo Throe and Lung contusion, L1 to L4 Vertebral fracture, Liver laceration, Left Clavicle Fracture, Left Ulnar nerve injury, deep abrasion on chest and both knee joint."

entities.text: Sri Hanumegowda C B vs Mr. Ramesh G
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. He got admitted in MSR Memorial Hospital from 02-10-2016 to 03-10-2016, and shifted to MSR Teaching Hospital from 03-10-2016 to 01-11-2016.
He was also hospitalized for a period one month.

Considering the nature of injuries and period of hospitalization, this Court finds that it is just and reasonable to grant Rs.60,000/- for injuries, Rs.40,000/- for pain and sufferings, Rs.30,000/- for loss of amenities, Rs.10,000/- for medical expenses, Rs.30,000/- for transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
6.
It is stated that petitioner was aged 28 years and working as a Driver in Vishakan C/o. Indego Air Lines and earning Rs.15,000/- per month.
But no evidence is produced to prove his income.

The accident is of the year 2016, as per the guidelines of Karnataka State Legal Services Authority,
notional income is to be taken as NC: 2025:KHC:34814 HC-KAR Rs.9,500/- per month.
Due to the injuries sustained in the accident, he might not have attended any other work at least for a period of 6 months.
Hence, towards 'loss of income during laid up period', an amount of Rs.57,000/- (9,500 x 6) is awarded.

7. Thus in all, award of compensation passed by the Tribunal is modified as under:
 Particulars Amount  in Rs.
 Injuries 60,000.00  Pain and suffering 40,000.00  Loss of amenities 30,000.00  Medical Expenses 10,000.00  Transportation, extra 30,000.00  nourishment and  attendant charges  Loss of income during laid 57,000.00  up period  Total 2,27,000.00 8.
Hence, the compensation is enhanced from Rs.50,000/- to Rs.2,27,000/- along with interest at 6% NC: 2025:KHC:34814 HC-KAR per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.

9. In the result, the following order is passed:
ORDER i.
Appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The judgment and award dated 20.10.2018 passed in M.V.C.No.7566/2016 by the Motor Vehicles Accident Claims Tribunal,
Bengaluru, (SCCH-14) is modified; iii.
